items.text: Hi Daniel, your parcel has been sitting at the West Hall mailroom since Monday. Items left beyond 14 days are sent back, and a $5 holding charge starts after Friday. Please collect it weekdays between 2:00 and 5:00 PM. — RA Kim

questions.stem: According to the email, what happens to packages kept at the mailroom longer than two weeks?

options.A: They are moved to the front desk.
options.B: They are held for an extra month.
options.C: They are sent back to the sender.
options.D: They are donated to campus charities.

questions.explanation: The email states that items left beyond 14 days are sent back, meaning they are returned to the sender.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about picking up the parcel?

options.A: He should wait until Monday to collect it.
options.B: He must bring a printed delivery slip.
options.C: He needs to pay before Friday.
options.D: He avoids the charge by collecting Friday.

questions.explanation: Since the $5 holding charge only starts after Friday, collecting the parcel on or before Friday means no charge is paid.

items.text: Fire Alarm Testing Notice — Balk Hall. System tests are scheduled for Tuesday, October 8, from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Alarms will sound repeatedly. Residents are not required to leave their rooms. Report faulty units to Facilities at 555-0142. Room access may be needed on floor 2.

questions.stem: According to the notice, when will the alarm testing occur?
questions.explanation: The notice gives the test date as Tuesday, October 8, running from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about residents living on floor 2?

options.A: They may be asked to leave the building.
options.B: They may receive a refund on their deposit.
options.C: They may need to call the Facilities line.
options.D: They may need to allow staff into rooms.

questions.explanation: The notice mentions that room access may be needed on floor 2, implying those residents could have to let workers into their rooms.

items.text: Recycling Bin Relocation — North Quad bins move to the Jensen Lot entrance on Monday, November 4. Old bins are removed at 8:00 AM that day. Glass and cardboard are accepted; plastic film is not. Questions? Email the Sustainability Office at green@univ.edu.

questions.stem: According to the notice, where will the recycling bins be placed?

options.A: At the entrance to Jensen Lot.
options.B: Inside the North Quad laundry room.

questions.explanation: The notice states that the North Quad bins are moving to the Jensen Lot entrance.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the old bins?

options.A: They will be moved to a storage area.
options.B: They will be gone after Monday morning.
options.C: They will accept glass and cardboard.
options.D: They will be replaced at noon on Monday.

questions.explanation: Because the old bins are removed at 8:00 AM on Monday, they will no longer be in place once that morning has passed.

items.text: Lost Property Notice — Field House. Unclaimed items held at the equipment desk will be discarded on Friday, December 6. Retrieval is available Monday to Thursday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. A $2 handling fee applies. Bring your student ID. Contact the front desk with questions.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what must a person bring to retrieve an item?

options.B: A signed form from the desk
options.D: A receipt from the Field House

questions.explanation: The notice instructs readers to bring their student ID when claiming an item.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what will happen to items that are never collected?

options.A: They will be sold at a campus auction.
options.C: They will be given to charity groups.
options.D: They will be kept until January.

questions.explanation: The notice says unclaimed items will be discarded on December 6, which means they are thrown away.
